questions.content:
如图所示，一个半径为 r 匀质圆筒从空中静止释放，与很长很长的斜面发生碰撞，从初态到第一次碰撞，圆心下降高度为 h. 碰撞过程中的恢复系数为 e，圆筒与斜面的摩擦系数为 μ，求

(1) N 次碰撞后质心的速度 v(N)

(2) N 次碰撞后自转的角速度 ω(N)

(3) 从第一次碰撞到第 N 次碰撞后质心沿斜面的位移 s(N)

![](data/images/2023-8387b0d1/2023-校级联考-联考-理论-第六套-1.png)
questions.analysis:
沿斜面建立坐标系，x轴平行于斜面且距离斜面 r，y轴垂直于斜面向上，以小球初次反弹瞬间球心的位置为原点；记第N次反弹前的速度为 u_x(N), u_y(N), ω'(N)，记反弹后瞬间的速度为 v_x(N), v_y(N), ω(N)。碰撞过程中，y方向受到冲量 I_{Ny} = -(1+e)u_y(N)；若x方向受到最大冲量 I_{Nx} = -μI_{Ny}，则碰撞前后的速度关系为

$$v_y(N) = -e u_y(N) \tag{1}$$

$$v_x(N) = u_x(N) + μ(1+e)u_y(N) \tag{2}$$

$$ω(N)r/2 = ω'(N)r/2 - μ(1+e)u_y(N) \tag{3}$$

水平方向冲量取最大值的条件是圆柱与斜面的接触点在碰撞后其水平分量大小不小于0。碰撞后相对速度计算如下：v_{rel}(N) = v_x(N) - ω(N)r

$$v_x(N) - ω(N)r ≥ 0 \tag{4}$$

$$u_x(N) + μ(1+e)u_y(N) - ω'(N)r + 2μ(1+e)u_y(N) ≥ 0 \tag{5}$$

$$u_x(N) - ω'(N)r + 3μ(1+e)u_y(N) ≥ 0 \tag{6}$$

再考虑重力作用下两次碰撞之间速度的变化

$$u_x(N+1) = v_x(N) + gΔt \sin θ \tag{7}$$

$$u_y(N+1) = -v_y(N) \tag{8}$$

$$ω'(N+1) = ω(N) \tag{9}$$

$$Δt = 2v_y(N)/(g \cos θ) \tag{10}$$

y方向的速度已经可以直接计算：

$$u_y(N) = -\sqrt{2gh} \cos θ e^{N-1} \tag{11}$$

$$v_y(N) = \sqrt{2gh} \cos θ e^{N} \tag{12}$$

在相对速度大于0的条件下，相邻两次碰撞后接触点的相对速度的变化量可以写为：

$$v_{rel}(N+1) - v_{rel}(N) = 3μ(1+e)u_y(N+1) + 2v_y(N) \tan θ \tag{13}$$

$$= [-3μ(1+e)\cos θ + 2\sin θ]\sqrt{2gh} e^{N} \tag{14}$$

由此可知，该相对速度的变化是单调的。

分类讨论如下：

$\tan θ > 3μ(1+e)$

此时相对速度不断增加。

x方向速度：

$$v_x(N) = v_x(N-1) + μ(1+e)u_y(N) + 2v_y(N-1)\tan θ \tag{15}$$

$$v_x(N) = v_x(N-1) - μ(1+e)\sqrt{2gh}\cos θ e^{N-1} + 2\sqrt{2gh}\cos θ e^{N-1}\tan θ \tag{16}$$

$$v_x(N) = v_x(N-1) + [-μ(1+e)\cos θ + 2\sin θ]\sqrt{2gh} e^{N-1} \tag{17}$$

$$v_x(N) = -\sqrt{2gh}\sin θ + [-μ(1+e)\cos θ + 2\sin θ]\frac{1-e^{N}}{1-e}\sqrt{2gh} \tag{18}$$

角速度：

$$ω(N)r = ω(N-1)r - 2μ(1+e)u_y(N)$$

$$ω(N)r = ω(N-1)r + 2μ(1+e)\sqrt{2gh} e^{N-1}\cos θ \tag{19}$$

$$ω(N) = \frac{2μ(1+e)\sqrt{2gh}}{r}\frac{1-e^{N}}{1-e}\cos θ \tag{21}$$

距离：

$$Δt(N) = 2\sqrt{2h/g} e^{N} \tag{22}$$

$$s(N) = \sum_{n=1}^{N-1}\left[v_x(n)Δt(n) + \frac{1}{2}g\sin θ Δt(n)^2\right] \tag{23}$$

$$s(N) = \sum_{n=1}^{N-1}4h\left\{\left\{-\sin θ + [-μ(1+e)\cos θ + 2\sin θ]\frac{1-e^{n}}{1-e}\right\}e^{n} + e^{2n}\sin θ\right\} \tag{24}$$

$$s(N) = \sum_{n=1}^{N-1}4h\left\{\left\{-\sin θ + \frac{1}{1-e}[-μ(1+e)\cos θ + 2\sin θ]\right\}e^{n}\right\} \tag{25}$$

$$+ \sum_{n=1}^{N-1}\left\{\left\{\sin θ - \frac{1}{1-e}[-μ(1+e)\cos θ + 2\sin θ]\right\}e^{2n}\right\} \tag{26}$$

$$s(N) = 4h\frac{e-e^{N}}{1-e}\left\{-\sin θ + \frac{1}{1-e}[-μ(1+e)\cos θ + 2\sin θ]\right\} \tag{27}$$

$$+ 4h\frac{e^{2}-e^{2N}}{1-e^{2}}\left\{\sin θ - \frac{1}{1-e}[-μ(1+e)\cos θ + 2\sin θ]\right\} \tag{28}$$

$$s(N) = 4h\frac{1+e}{1-e}(\sin θ - μ\cos θ)\left(\frac{e-e^{N}}{1-e} - \frac{e^{2}-e^{2N}}{1-e^{2}}\right) \tag{29}$$

$3μ(1+e)/2 < \tan θ ≤ 3μ(1+e)$

此时首次碰撞后接触点相对静止。碰撞过程中角动量守恒，首次碰撞后的速度：

$$v_y(1) = e\sqrt{2gh}\cos θ \tag{30}$$

$$v_x(1) = ω(1)r = \frac{2}{3}\sqrt{2gh}\sin θ \tag{31}$$

此后推导类似上一种情况。

$$v_x(N) = v_x(N-1) + [-μ(1+e)\cos θ + 2\sin θ]\sqrt{2gh} e^{N-1} \tag{32}$$

$$v_x(N) = \left[μ(1+e)\cos θ - \frac{4}{3}\sin θ\right]\sqrt{2gh} + [-μ(1+e)\cos θ + 2\sin θ]\frac{1-e^{N}}{1-e}\sqrt{2gh} \tag{33}$$

$$ω(N) = \frac{\sqrt{2gh}}{r}\left[\frac{2}{3}\sin θ + 2μ(1+e)\frac{e-e^{N}}{1-e}\cos θ\right] \tag{34}$$

计算横向距离时可看作全过程的平均速度相差 $[μ(1+e)\cos θ - \sin θ/3]\sqrt{2gh}$

$$s(N) = 4h\frac{1+e}{1-e}(\sin θ - μ\cos θ)\left(\frac{e-e^{N}}{1-e} - \frac{e^{2}-e^{2N}}{1-e^{2}}\right) + [μ(1+e)\cos θ - \sin θ/3]\sqrt{2gh}\sum_{n=1}^{N-1}Δt(n) \tag{35}$$

$$s(N) = 4h\frac{1+e}{1-e}(\sin θ - μ\cos θ)\left(\frac{e-e^{N}}{1-e} - \frac{e^{2}-e^{2N}}{1-e^{2}}\right) + 4h[μ(1+e)\cos θ - \sin θ/3]\frac{e-e^{N}}{1-e} \tag{36}$$

$\tan θ ≤ 3μ(1+e)/2$

此时每次弹跳后相对速度为0。

$$v_x(N+1) + \frac{1}{2}ω(N+1)r = v_x(N) + \frac{1}{2}ω(N)r + 2\sqrt{2gh} e^{N}\sin θ \tag{37}$$

$$v_x(N) + \frac{1}{2}ω(N)r = \sqrt{2gh}\sin θ\left(2\frac{1-e^{N}}{1-e} - 1\right) \tag{38}$$

$$v_x(N) = ω(N)r = \frac{2}{3}\sqrt{2gh}\sin θ\left(2\frac{1-e^{N}}{1-e} - 1\right) \tag{39}$$

$$s(N) = \sum_{n=1}^{N-1}\left[v_x(n)Δt(n) + \frac{1}{2}g\sin θ Δt(n)^2\right] \tag{40}$$

$$s(N) = 4h\sin θ\sum_{n=1}^{N-1}\left[\frac{2(1+e)}{3(1-e)}e^{n} - \frac{1+3e}{3(1-e)}e^{2n}\right] \tag{41}$$

$$s(N) = 4h\sin θ\left[\frac{2(1+e)}{3(1-e)}\frac{e-e^{N}}{1-e} - \frac{1+3e}{3(1-e)}\frac{e^{2}-e^{2N}}{1-e^{2}}\right] \tag{42}$$
questions.answer:
(1) 质心速度 $v_x(N)$ 与 $v_y(N)$ 分情况给出：

- 当 $\tan θ > 3μ(1+e)$ 时，$v_x(N) = -\sqrt{2gh}\sin θ + [-μ(1+e)\cos θ + 2\sin θ]\frac{1-e^{N}}{1-e}\sqrt{2gh}$，$v_y(N) = \sqrt{2gh}\cos θ e^{N}$；
- 当 $3μ(1+e)/2 < \tan θ ≤ 3μ(1+e)$ 时，$v_x(N) = \left[μ(1+e)\cos θ - \frac{4}{3}\sin θ\right]\sqrt{2gh} + [-μ(1+e)\cos θ + 2\sin θ]\frac{1-e^{N}}{1-e}\sqrt{2gh}$，$v_y(N) = \sqrt{2gh}\cos θ e^{N}$；
- 当 $\tan θ ≤ 3μ(1+e)/2$ 时，$v_x(N) = \frac{2}{3}\sqrt{2gh}\sin θ\left(2\frac{1-e^{N}}{1-e} - 1\right)$，$v_y(N) = \sqrt{2gh}\cos θ e^{N}$。

(2) 角速度 $ω(N)$：

- 当 $\tan θ > 3μ(1+e)$ 时，$ω(N) = \frac{2μ(1+e)\sqrt{2gh}}{r}\frac{1-e^{N}}{1-e}\cos θ$；
- 当 $3μ(1+e)/2 < \tan θ ≤ 3μ(1+e)$ 时，$ω(N) = \frac{\sqrt{2gh}}{r}\left[\frac{2}{3}\sin θ + 2μ(1+e)\frac{e-e^{N}}{1-e}\cos θ\right]$；
- 当 $\tan θ ≤ 3μ(1+e)/2$ 时，$ω(N) = \frac{2}{3}\frac{\sqrt{2gh}}{r}\sin θ\left(2\frac{1-e^{N}}{1-e} - 1\right)$。

(3) 位移 $s(N)$：

- 当 $\tan θ > 3μ(1+e)$ 时，$s(N) = 4h\frac{1+e}{1-e}(\sin θ - μ\cos θ)\left(\frac{e-e^{N}}{1-e} - \frac{e^{2}-e^{2N}}{1-e^{2}}\right)$；
- 当 $3μ(1+e)/2 < \tan θ ≤ 3μ(1+e)$ 时，$s(N) = 4h\frac{1+e}{1-e}(\sin θ - μ\cos θ)\left(\frac{e-e^{N}}{1-e} - \frac{e^{2}-e^{2N}}{1-e^{2}}\right) + 4h[μ(1+e)\cos θ - \sin θ/3]\frac{e-e^{N}}{1-e}$；
- 当 $\tan θ ≤ 3μ(1+e)/2$ 时，$s(N) = 4h\sin θ\left[\frac{2(1+e)}{3(1-e)}\frac{e-e^{N}}{1-e} - \frac{1+3e}{3(1-e)}\frac{e^{2}-e^{2N}}{1-e^{2}}\right]$。

questions.content:
二、 二球体（60 分）

如图两个实心球体固连在一起，我们将其称为二球体. 已知 $R_{1} = 2\,\mathrm{cm}$，$R_{2}=4\,\mathrm{cm}$，实心球材料的密度为 $\rho = 1.5 \times 10^{3}\,\mathrm{kg}\cdot\mathrm{m}^{-3}$

Part 1.

（1.1） 求二球体关于两球心连线的转动惯量 $I_{\parallel}$

（1.2） 求二球体关于过质心且垂直于纸面的轴的转动惯量 $I_{\perp}$ .

![](data/images/2023-8387b0d1/2023-校级联考-联考-理论-第六套-2.png)

Part 2. 将二球体立在一个水平面上，小球在下，大球在上，保持球心连线竖直

(2.1) 若二球体与地面之间保持光滑，受到微扰的二球体开始倒下，求大球触地前瞬间，两个球的球心速度大小.

(2.2) 若小球与地面之间摩擦系数足够大，使得二球体与地面之间始终没有相对滑动，求大球触地前瞬间，两个球的球心速度大小.

![](data/images/2023-8387b0d1/2023-校级联考-联考-理论-第六套-3.png)

Part 3. 将二球体放在一个与水平面倾角为 $\alpha = 30^{\circ}$ 的大粗糙斜面上，在此部分斜面与二球体之间摩擦足够大，两者之间未发生相对滑动. 初态两球与斜面的接触点连线保持水平，静止释放.

(3.1) 求在之后运动过程中，两个球的球心的最大速率.

(3.2) 求当两球球心速率达到最大值的瞬间，二球体的角加速度大小.

(3.3) 在此斜面上，存在一个位置使得二球体处于稳定平衡，求在此稳定平衡位置附近的小振动周期.

![](data/images/2023-8387b0d1/2023-校级联考-联考-理论-第六套-4.png)
questions.analysis:
解析:

(1.1)

$$
I _ { \parallel } = \frac { 2 } { 5 } m _ { 1 } R _ { 1 } ^ { 2 } + \frac { 2 } { 5 } m _ { 2 } R _ { 2 } ^ { 2 } = \frac { 8 \pi } { 1 5 } \rho ( R _ { 1 } ^ { 5 } + R _ { 2 } ^ { 5 } ) = 2 . 6 5 4 \cdot 1 0 ^ { - 4 } \operatorname { k g } \operatorname { m } ^ { 2 } .\tag{1.2}
$$

$$
I _ { \perp } = \frac { 2 } { 5 } m _ { 1 } R _ { 1 } ^ { 2 } + m _ { 1 } x _ { 0 } ^ { 2 } + \frac { 2 } { 5 } m _ { 2 } R _ { 2 } ^ { 2 } + m _ { 2 } x _ { 0 } ^ { \prime 2 } = \frac { 8 \pi } { 1 5 } \rho ( R _ { 1 } ^ { 5 } + R _ { 2 } ^ { 5 } ) + \frac { 4 \pi } { 3 } \rho \frac { R _ { 1 } ^ { 3 } R _ { 2 } ^ { 3 } ( R _ { 1 } + R _ { 2 } ) } { R _ { 1 } ^ { 2 } - R _ { 1 } R _ { 2 } + R _ { 2 } ^ { 2 } } = 4 . 2 6 3 \cdot 1 0 ^ { - 4 } \operatorname { k g } \operatorname { m } ^ { 2 } .\tag{2.1}
$$

2 As there is no friction in the system, there is no horizontal force at all, therefore the horizontal component of the system's momentum is conserved and since it was 0 initially, it will be 0 in the final setup as well. Consequently, the horizontal component of the CM's velocity is 0, thus it will move vertically. The center of the lower ball must have a purely horizontal velocity, as the contact point with the ground can only move so and its relative velocity to the mentioned center is horizontal too (it is a peripheral speed related to a vertical position vector).

The vector from the CM to the center of the lower ball in the final state (Figure 2) is $\mathbf { r } _ { 1 } = x _ { 0 } ( - \sin \alpha , \cos \alpha )$ , thus the vector of the relative velocity is $\mathbf { v } _ { \mathrm { r e l , 1 } } = \boldsymbol { \omega } \times \mathbf { r } _ { 1 } = x _ { 0 } \boldsymbol { \omega } ( \cos \alpha , \sin \alpha )$. The only way to decompose this into the difference of a horizontal and a vertical velocity vector (as required by the above conditions) gives the velocity of the CM as $v_{\mathrm{CM}} = -x_0\omega\sin\alpha$ (and that of the center of the lower ball as $v _ { 1 } = x _ { 0 } \omega \cos \alpha$ ).

The kinetic energy of the system right before the collision is given as the sum of the translational kinetic energy due to $v_{\mathrm{CM}}$ and the rotational energy: this must be equal to the reduction of potential energy, which is $2m_2gR_1$ (see above):

$$
\begin{aligned} & \frac { 1 } { 2 } ( m _ { 1 } + m _ { 2 } ) v _ { \operatorname { C M } } ^ { 2 } + \frac { 1 } { 2 } I _ { \perp } \omega ^ { 2 } = 2 m _ { 2 } g R _ { 1 } \\ & \omega ^ { 2 } \left( x _ { 0 } ^ { 2 } \omega ^ { 2 } \operatorname { s i n } ^ { 2 } \alpha ( m _ { 1 } + m _ { 2 } ) + I _ { \perp } \right) = 4 m _ { 2 } g R _ { 1 } \\ & \omega = \sqrt { \frac { 4 m _ { 2 } g R _ { 1 } } { x _ { 0 } ^ { 2 } \omega ^ { 2 } \operatorname { s i n } ^ { 2 } \alpha ( m _ { 1 } + m _ { 2 } ) + I _ { \perp } } } = \sqrt { \frac { 2 0 R _ { 2 } ^ { 3 } R _ { 1 } ( R _ { 1 } ^ { 3 } + R _ { 2 } ^ { 3 } ) g } { 2 R _ { 1 } ^ { 8 } + 7 R _ { 1 } ^ { 5 } R _ { 2 } ^ { 3 } + 1 0 R _ { 1 } ^ { 4 } R _ { 2 } ^ { 4 } + 7 R _ { 1 } ^ { 3 } R _ { 2 } ^ { 5 } + 2 0 R _ { 1 } R _ { 2 } ^ { 7 } + 2 R _ { 2 } ^ { 8 } } } . \end{aligned}
$$

(We have used that $\sin ^ { 2 } \alpha = 1 - \cos ^ { 2 } \alpha = \frac { 4 R _ { 1 } R _ { 2 } } { ( R _ { 1 } + R _ { 2 } ) ^ { 2 } } .$ )

The velocity of the center of the lower ball is horizontal and its magnitude is

$$
v _ { 1 } = x _ { 0 } \omega \cos \alpha = \sqrt { \frac { 2 0 R _ { 2 } ^ { 9 } R _ { 1 } ( R _ { 1 } - R _ { 2 } ) ^ { 2 } g } { ( 2 R _ { 1 } ^ { 8 } + 7 R _ { 1 } ^ { 5 } R _ { 2 } ^ { 3 } + 1 0 R _ { 1 } ^ { 4 } R _ { 2 } ^ { 2 } + 7 R _ { 1 } ^ { 3 } R _ { 2 } ^ { 5 } + 2 0 R _ { 1 } R _ { 2 } ^ { 7 } + 2 R _ { 2 } ^ { 8 } ) ( R _ { 1 } ^ { 3 } + R _ { 2 } ^ { 3 } ) } } = 0 . 2 5 1 9 \frac { \mathrm { m } } { \mathrm { s } } .
$$

The distance vector from the center of ball 1 to that of ball 2 is $\mathbf { d } = ( R _ { 1 } + R _ { 2 } ) ( \sin \alpha , - \cos \alpha )$ so the relative velocity of the center of ball 2 to that of ball 1 is $\mathbf { v } _ { \mathrm { r e l } } = \mathbf { \omega } \times \mathbf { d } = ( R _ { 1 } + R _ { 2 } ) \omega ( - \cos \alpha , - \sin \alpha )$; since the velocity vector of the center of ball 1 is $\mathbf { v } _ { 1 } = ( x _ { 0 } \omega \cos \alpha , 0 )$ , that of ball 2 is

$$
\mathbf { v } _ { 2 } = \omega ( - x _ { 0 } ^ { \prime } \operatorname { c o s } \alpha , - ( R _ { 1 } + R _ { 2 } ) \operatorname { s i n } \alpha ) .
$$

The angle $\beta$ between this vector and the positive x-axis is given by

$$
\tan \beta = \frac{v_{2y}}{v_{2x}} = \frac{R_1 + R_2}{x_0'} \tan \alpha = \frac{R_1^3 + R_2^3}{R_1^3} \cdot \frac{2\sqrt{R_1 R_2}}{R_1 - R_2} \rightarrow \beta = \arctan \left( \frac{2\sqrt{R_1 R_2}}{R_1 - R_2} \frac{R_1^3 + R_2^3}{R_1^3} \right) = - 87.75^0,
$$

while its magnitude is

$$
\begin{aligned} &v_{2} = \left| \mathbf{v}_{2} \right| = \omega \sqrt{x_{0}^{\prime 2} \cos^{2} \alpha + (R_{1} + R_{2})^{2} \sin^{2} \alpha} =\\ &= \sqrt{\frac{20R_{2}^{3}R_{1}^{2}g(R_{1}^{7} + 2R_{1}^{6}R_{2} + R_{1}^{5}R_{2}^{2} + 8R_{1}^{3}R_{2}^{4} + 4R_{2}^{7})}{(2R_{1}^{8} + 7R_{1}^{6}R_{2}^{3} + 10R_{1}^{4}R_{2}^{4} + 7R_{1}^{3}R_{2}^{5} + 20R_{1}R_{2}^{7} + 2R_{2}^{8})(R_{1}^{3} + R_{2}^{3})}} = 0.8022 \frac{\mathrm{m}}{\mathrm{s}}.\\ \end{aligned}
$$

(2.2)

1 The body will constitute pure rolling, therefore the contact point with the ground will always be a momentary rotation center of the motion. The kinetic energy of the body is therefore $\frac { 1 } { 2 } I \omega ^ { 2 }$ where I is the moment of inertia with respect to that point. Now we're going to calculate this moment of inertia at the moment of the collision. The cosine of $\alpha$ in the figure is clearly $\cos \alpha = - \sin(\alpha - 90^{\circ}) = - \frac { R _ { 2 } - R _ { 1 } } { R _ { 2 } + R _ { 1 } } = \frac { R _ { 1 } - R _ { 2 } } { R _ { 1 } + R _ { 2 } }$ . From the law of cosines we get for the distance of the CM and the rotation center $d ^ { 2 } = R _ { 1 } ^ { 2 } + x _ { 0 } ^ { 2 } - 2 R _ { 1 } x _ { 0 } \cos \alpha$; by Steiner's theorem

$$
I = I _ { \perp } + ( m _ { 1 } + m _ { 2 } ) d ^ { 2 } = \frac { 4 \pi } { 1 5 } \rho ( 7 R _ { 1 } ^ { 5 } + 7 R _ { 2 } ^ { 5 } + 2 0 R _ { 1 } R _ { 2 } ^ { 4 } ) .
$$

The kinetic energy is on the other hand the change of gravitational potential energy of the system: that of the lower ball doesn’t vary as its CM moves only horizontally, but the potential energy of the upper ball changes from (with choosing $V = 0$ at ground level) $m _ { 2 } g ( 2 R _ { 1 } + R _ { 2 } )$ to $m _ { 2 } g R _ { 2 }$ . By the conservation of energy:

$$
m _ { 2 } g ( 2 R _ { 1 } + R _ { 2 } ) = m _ { 2 } g R _ { 2 } + \frac { 1 } { 2 } I \omega ^ { 2 }
$$

$$
\omega = \sqrt { \frac { 4 m _ { 2 } g R _ { 1 } } { I } } = \sqrt { \frac { 2 0 R _ { 2 } ^ { 3 } R _ { 1 } g } { 7 R _ { 1 } ^ { 5 } + 7 R _ { 2 } ^ { 5 } + 2 0 R _ { 1 } R _ { 2 } ^ { 4 } } } .
$$

The velocities of the balls’ centers can be found from the fact that the ground contact point is the momentary center of rotation, therefore the velocity of each point of the body is $r\omega$ where r is the distance of this point and the ground contact point and the velocity vector is perpendicular to the line joining them (this is shown in the sketch). The distance of the center of ball 1 to the ground contact point is $R _ { 1 }$ , thus its velocity is

$$
v _ { 1 } = R _ { 1 } \omega = \sqrt { \frac { 2 0 R _ { 2 } ^ { 3 } R _ { 1 } ^ { 3 } g } { 7 R _ { 1 } ^ { 5 } + 7 R _ { 2 } ^ { 5 } + 2 0 R _ { 1 } R _ { 2 } ^ { 4 } } } = 0 . 2 3 8 6 \frac { \mathrm { m } } { \mathrm { s } } ;
$$

that for ball 2 is $r _ { 2 } = \sqrt { R _ { 1 } ^ { 2 } + ( R _ { 1 } + R _ { 2 } ) ^ { 2 } - 2 R _ { 1 } ( R _ { 1 } + R _ { 2 } ) \cos \alpha } = \sqrt { 4 R _ { 1 } R _ { 2 } + R _ { 2 } ^ { 2 } }$ , thus

$$
v _ { 2 } = r _ { 2 } \omega = \sqrt { \frac { 2 0 R _ { 2 } ^ { 4 } R _ { 1 } ( 4 R _ { 1 } + R _ { 2 } ) g } { 7 R _ { 1 } ^ { 5 } + 7 R _ { 2 } ^ { 5 } + 2 0 R _ { 1 } R _ { 2 } ^ { 4 } } } = 0 . 8 2 6 4 \frac { \mathrm { m } } { \mathrm { s } } .
$$

![](data/images/2023-8387b0d1/2023-校级联考-联考-理论-第六套-答案-5.png)

Figure 1. The setup of the system immediately before the collision in Part B.1.

Both contact points with the ground will move without slipping. Consequently, if the body rotates about its symmetry axis by some angle, these points will move by distances the ratio of which is $R _ { 2 } / R _ { 1 }$ this means that the orbits of these points are two concentrical circles with radii of this ratio. The common center of these circles will be a permanent center of the rotation, therefore we will calculate with respect to axes passing through this point. Now we determine the distance D of this center to the CM. As the center O must be the intersection point of the symmetry axis $O _ { 1 } O _ { 2 }$ and the plane the body is placed on we can write down the following equation due to the similar right triangles $O O _ { 1 } T _ { 1 }$ and $O O _ { 2 } T _ { 2 }$

$$
\frac { D + x _ { 0 } ^ { \prime } } { R _ { 2 } } = \frac { D - x _ { 0 } } { R _ { 1 } } \to D = \frac { R _ { 1 } ^ { 4 } + R _ { 2 } ^ { 4 } } { ( R _ { 1 } ^ { 2 } - R _ { 1 } R _ { 2 } + R _ { 2 } ^ { 2 } ) ( R _ { 2 } - R _ { 1 } ) } .
$$

However, the line joining the touching points of the body and the plane is the momentary rotational axis of the body due to the slipless motion. Therefore, the angular velocity vector $\omega$ must be in this line. The angle $\gamma$ in the figure can simply be expressed by $\sin \gamma = \frac { R _ { 2 } - R _ { 1 } } { R _ { 2 } + R _ { 1 } } \to \cos \gamma = \frac { 2 \sqrt { R _ { 1 } R _ { 2 } } } { R _ { 1 } + R _ { 2 } }$ , so the components of this vector in the principal coordinate system are $\omega _ { 1 } = \omega \sin \gamma$ and $\omega _2 = \omega \cos \gamma$. The moments of inertia with respect to axes passing through this point are $I _ { \perp } + ( m _ { 1 } + m _ { 2 } ) D ^ { 2 }$ and $I _ { \parallel }$ respectively.

Now we're going to write down the total energy of the system. The kinetic energy can be written solely as rotational energy with respect to point O: using the above expressions of the moments of inertia and angular velocities we find

$$
K = \frac { 1 } { 2 } ( I _ { \perp } + ( m _ { 1 } + m _ { 2 } ) D ^ { 2 } ) \omega ^ { 2 } \operatorname { s i n } ^ { 2 } \gamma + \frac { 1 } { 2 } I _ { \parallel } \omega ^ { 2 } \operatorname { c o s } ^ { 2 } \gamma = \frac { 1 4 \pi } { 1 5 } \rho \omega ^ { 2 } ( R _ { 1 } ^ { 5 } + R _ { 2 } ^ { 5 } ) .
$$

The CM of the system is moving on a circle in a plane somewhat above the inclined plane and parallel to it. The radius of this circle is $R = D \cos \gamma = \frac{2(R_1^4 + R_2^4)\sqrt{R_1 R_2}}{(R_1^2 - R_1 R_2 + R_2^2)(R_2^2 - R_1^2)}$ . Let $\theta$ be the angle between the line joining the touching points and the horizontal edge of the plane. If we choose the zero level of the gravitational potential energy at the state $\theta = \pi / 2$ , we can simply express the potential energy as

$$
V = ( m _ { 1 } + m _ { 2 } ) g \Delta h = - ( m _ { 1 } + m _ { 2 } ) g R \operatorname { c o s } \theta \operatorname { s i n } \alpha = \frac { 8 \pi } { 3 } \rho g \frac { R _ { 1 } ^ { 4 } + R _ { 2 } ^ { 4 } } { R _ { 1 } - R _ { 2 } } \sqrt { R _ { 1 } R _ { 2 } } \operatorname { c o s } \theta \operatorname { s i n } \alpha .
$$

As there is no energy loss due to friction, the total energy $K + V$ is constant.

1 The energy initially is 0 as $\omega = 0$ and $\theta = \pi / 2$; due to the conservation of energy, this will hold all along the motion. Therefore, the less is the potential energy, the more is the kinetic energy and so the velocities. From the expression of V we can see that the minimal potential energy at $\theta = 0$ is $\frac { 8 \pi } { 3 } \rho g \frac { R _ { 1 } ^ { 4 } + R _ { 2 } ^ { 4 } } { R _ { 1 } - R _ { 2 } } \sqrt { R _ { 1 } R _ { 2 } } \sin \alpha$, the opposite of which is the maximal kinetic energy:

$$
\frac { 8 \pi } { 3 } \rho g \frac { R _ { 1 } ^ { 4 } + R _ { 2 } ^ { 4 } } { R _ { 2 } - R _ { 1 } } \sqrt { R _ { 1 } R _ { 2 } } \operatorname { s i n } \alpha = \frac { 1 4 \pi } { 1 5 } \rho \omega _ { \operatorname* { m a x } } ^ { 2 } ( R _ { 1 } ^ { 5 } + R _ { 2 } ^ { 5 } )
$$

2 The magnitude of $\omega$ is maximal in this point, therefore it doesn’t change in the first order. However, its direction is varying over time, and this causes an angular acceleration like in the case of centripetal acceleration. We are now going to calculate the angular velocity $\Omega = \dot { \theta }$ of the rotation of the axis $T _ { 1 } T _ { 2 }$; as its vector is perpendicular to the inclined plane, we find $\dot { \boldsymbol { \omega } } = \boldsymbol { \Omega } \times \boldsymbol { \omega }$ and so $| \dot { \omega } | = \Omega \omega$

It is easy to see that the velocities of the points lying on the axis of the body can be expressed as peripheral speeds due to $\Omega$ and $\omega$ as well. In the special case of the CM we'll find them as $v _ { \mathrm { C M } } = D \sin \gamma \cdot \omega = D \cos \gamma \cdot \Omega$, thus $\Omega = \omega \tan \gamma$ . Consequently, the requested “centripetal” angular acceleration is (we have used that $\tan \gamma = \frac { R _ { 2 } - R _ { 1 } } { 2 \sqrt { R _ { 1 } R _ { 2 } } }$ )

$$
\left| \dot { \omega } \right| = \omega ^ { 2 } \tan \gamma = \frac { 1 0 } { 7 } g \frac { R _ { 1 } ^ { 4 } + R _ { 2 } ^ { 4 } } { R _ { 1 } ^ { 5 } + R _ { 2 } ^ { 5 } } \sin \alpha = 1 8 0 . 3 ~ \mathrm { s ^ { - 2 } } .
$$

3 We have the equation $\dot { \theta } = \Omega = \omega \tan \gamma$; substituting this into the conservation of energy yields that

$$
\frac { 8 \pi } { 3 } \rho g \frac { R _ { 1 } ^ { 4 } + R _ { 2 } ^ { 4 } } { R _ { 1 } - R _ { 2 } } \sqrt { R _ { 1 } R _ { 2 } } \operatorname { c o s } \theta \operatorname { s i n } \alpha + \frac { 5 6 \pi } { 1 5 } \rho \frac { ( R _ { 1 } ^ { 5 } + R _ { 2 } ^ { 5 } ) R _ { 1 } R _ { 2 } } { ( R _ { 1 } - R _ { 2 } ) ^ { 2 } } \left( \dot { \theta } \right) ^ { 2 }
$$

is constant, therefore its time derivative is $0$. As the only parameter varying by time is $\theta$, we'll have a differential equation in $\theta$. This equation may be simplified and as $\theta$ is very small, we may use first-order approximations. Using these simplifications we'll get

$$
5 g ( R _ { 1 } ^ { 4 } + R _ { 2 } ^ { 4 } ) \operatorname { s i n } \alpha \cdot \theta = 1 4 \frac { R _ { 1 } ^ { 5 } + R _ { 2 } ^ { 5 } } { R _ { 1 } - R _ { 2 } } \sqrt { R _ { 1 } R _ { 2 } } \cdot \ddot { \theta } ;
$$

from this harmonic equation we can easily get the angular frequency:

$$
\Omega _ { 0 } = \sqrt { \frac { 5 g } { 1 4 } \frac { ( R _ { 1 } ^ { 4 } + R _ { 2 } ^ { 4 } ) ( R _ { 2 } - R _ { 1 } ) } { ( R _ { 1 } ^ { 5 } + R _ { 2 } ^ { 5 } ) \sqrt { R _ { 1 } R _ { 2 } } } \sin \alpha } = 5 . 6 4 6 \mathrm { s ^ { - 1 } } .
$$

questions.content:
半径为 $R$ 的不接地不带电导体球外，放置一个电偶极矩为 $p$ 的电偶极子，方向与球心连线为 $\theta$。电偶极子距球心 $2R$。求

(1) 系统电势能

(2) 电偶极子的受力

(3) 若电偶极子的中心被固定不可平移，但是可以无摩擦地绕中心旋转。已知该电偶极子绕中心的转动惯量为 $I$，找到电偶极子的稳定平衡位置并求解在稳定平衡位置附近做小角度振动的周期。

questions.answer:
(1) 系统电势能 $U = \dfrac{p^2(32 + 11\cos^2\theta)}{3456\pi\varepsilon_0 R^3}$

(2) 电偶极子受力 $F_x = -\dfrac{p^2}{\pi\varepsilon_0 R^4}\left(\dfrac{1}{27} + \dfrac{1}{64}\cos^2\theta\right)$，$F_y = -\dfrac{37p^2\sin\theta\cos\theta}{3456\pi\varepsilon_0 R^4}$

(3) 稳定平衡位置 $\theta = \pi/2, 3\pi/2$，小角度振动周期 $T = \dfrac{48\pi}{5p}\sqrt{\pi\varepsilon_0 R^3 I}$

score.note: 考察圆柱坐标系下的热传导方程（泊松方程）及边界条件匹配。关键步骤是建立径向热流平衡微分方程并利用斯特藩-玻尔兹曼定律确定外边界温度。难点在于多层介质边界条件的处理及第三问非均匀电流密度下的积分运算，属常规竞赛热学综合题。

questions.content:
在导线通电时，会产生热量，我们考虑圆柱形导线，沿轴向方向可视为无穷长，内部由铜芯构成，内半径为 R，材质均匀，电阻率为 $\rho$，导热系数为 $\lambda_1$。在铜芯外包裹了一层黑色橡胶皮层，厚度为 $d$，导热系数为 $\lambda_2$，橡胶皮层对外以热辐射为主，与空气之间的热传导可以忽略，环境温度为 $T_0$。已知斯特潘常数为 $\sigma$。

（1）若通直流电，电流密度为 $j_0$。求解热平衡时，铜芯内部的温度分布 $T(r)$

（2）接第一问，求橡胶皮层外表面的温度 $T_2$

（3）若铜芯内部电流分布并不均匀，电流密度满足 $j(r) = j_0 \exp(\alpha r)$，$j_0$ 和 $\alpha$ 均为已知常数，求铜芯内部的径向温度梯度分布 $T'(r)$

![](data/images/2023-8387b0d1/2023-校级联考-联考-理论-第六套-6.png)
questions.analysis:
解:（1）分析铜芯内部，有

$$
- \lambda _ { 1 } \cdot 2 \pi r L \frac { \mathrm { d } T } { \mathrm { d } r } \bigg | _ { r } + \rho j ^ { 2 } ( r ) \cdot 2 \pi r L \mathrm { d } r = - \lambda _ { 1 } \cdot 2 \pi r L \frac { \mathrm { d } T } { \mathrm { d } r } \bigg | _ { r + \mathrm { d } r }\tag{1}
$$

解得

$$
r \frac { \mathrm { d } T } { \mathrm { d } r } = - \frac { \rho } { \lambda _ { 1 } } \int _ { 0 } ^ { r } r _ { 1 } j ^ { 2 } ( r _ { 1 } ) \mathrm { d } r _ { 1 } ,\tag{2}
$$

对于直流电， $j = j _ { 0 }$ ，故

$$
r \frac { \mathrm { d } T } { \mathrm { d } r } = - \frac { \rho j _ { 0 } ^ { 2 } } { 2 \lambda _ { 1 } } r ^ { 2 } \Rightarrow T = T _ { i } - \frac { \rho j _ { 0 } ^ { 2 } } { 4 \lambda _ { 1 } } r ^ { 2 } .\tag{3}
$$

能流连续，故

$$
\sigma ( T _ { 2 } ^ { 4 } - T _ { 0 } ^ { 4 } ) ( R + d ) = \frac { 1 } { 2 } \rho j _ { 0 } ^ { 2 } R ^ { 2 } \Rightarrow T _ { 2 } = \left( T _ { 0 } ^ { 4 } + \frac { \rho j _ { 0 } ^ { 2 } R ^ { 2 } } { 2 \sigma ( R + d ) } \right) ^ { \frac { 1 } { 4 } }\tag{4}
$$

在橡胶皮层内部，使用同样方法，可得

$$
\frac { \mathrm { d } T } { \mathrm { d } r } = - \frac { \rho j _ { 0 } ^ { 2 } R ^ { 2 } } { 2 \lambda _ { 2 } r } .\tag{5}
$$

则

$$
T _ { 2 } - T _ { 1 } = - \frac { \rho j _ { 0 } ^ { 2 } R ^ { 2 } } { 2 \lambda _ { 2 } } \ln \frac { R + d } { R }\tag{6}
$$

$r = R$ 处温度连续，故

$$
T _ { i } = \frac { \rho j _ { 0 } ^ { 2 } } { 4 \lambda _ { 1 } } R ^ { 2 } + \left( T _ { 0 } ^ { 4 } + \frac { \rho j _ { 0 } ^ { 2 } R ^ { 2 } } { 2 \sigma ( R + d ) } \right) ^ { \frac { 1 } { 4 } } + \frac { \rho j _ { 0 } ^ { 2 } R ^ { 2 } } { 2 \lambda _ { 2 } } \ln \frac { R + d } { R }\tag{7}
$$

内部温度分布为

$$
T ( r ) = \frac { \rho j _ { 0 } ^ { 2 } } { 4 \lambda _ { 1 } } ( R ^ { 2 } - r ^ { 2 } ) + \left( T _ { 0 } ^ { 4 } + \frac { \rho j _ { 0 } ^ { 2 } R ^ { 2 } } { 2 \sigma ( R + d ) } \right) ^ { \frac { 1 } { 4 } } + \frac { \rho j _ { 0 } ^ { 2 } R ^ { 2 } } { 2 \lambda _ { 2 } } \ln \frac { R + d } { R }\tag{8}
$$

（2）第一问已求得

$$
T _ { 2 } = \left( T _ { 0 } ^ { 4 } + \frac { \rho j _ { 0 } ^ { 2 } R ^ { 2 } } { 2 \sigma ( R + d ) } \right) ^ { \frac { 1 } { 4 } }\tag{9}
$$

（3）运用 (2) 式，积分得

$$
r \frac { \mathrm { d } T } { \mathrm { d } r } = - \frac { \rho j _ { 0 } ^ { 2 } } { \lambda _ { 1 } } \int _ { 0 } ^ { r } r _ { 1 } \exp ( 2 \alpha r _ { 1 } ) \mathrm { d } r _ { 1 } = - \frac { \rho j _ { 0 } ^ { 2 } } { 4 \alpha ^ { 2 } \lambda _ { 1 } } ( 1 + ( 2 \alpha r - 1 ) e ^ { 2 \alpha r } )\tag{10}
$$

解得

$$
T ^ { \prime } ( r ) = - \frac { \rho j _ { 0 } ^ { 2 } } { 4 \alpha ^ { 2 } \lambda _ { 1 } r } ( 1 + ( 2 \alpha r - 1 ) e ^ { 2 \alpha r } ) .\tag{11}
$$

评分标准:

（1）（2）共 32 分，(1)(2)(3)(4)(5)(6)(7)(8)式各 4 分；

（3）共 8 分，(10)(11)式各 4 分.

![](data/images/2023-8387b0d1/2023-校级联考-联考-理论-第六套-答案-8.png)
questions.answer:
（1）$T(r) = \dfrac{\rho j_0^2}{4\lambda_1}(R^2 - r^2) + \left(T_0^4 + \dfrac{\rho j_0^2 R^2}{2\sigma(R+d)}\right)^{1/4} + \dfrac{\rho j_0^2 R^2}{2\lambda_2}\ln\dfrac{R+d}{R}$

（2）$T_2 = \left(T_0^4 + \dfrac{\rho j_0^2 R^2}{2\sigma(R+d)}\right)^{1/4}$

（3）$T'(r) = -\dfrac{\rho j_0^2}{4\alpha^2\lambda_1 r}\left[1 + (2\alpha r - 1)e^{2\alpha r}\right]$

questions.title: 第 05 题
tags: 光学/波动光学/干涉/多缝干涉
光学/波动光学/干涉/空间相干性

score.note: 三缝干涉模型，关键在识别中缝与光源距离不同引入的固定相位差，以及扩展光源的非相干叠加。计算量大且易错，属中上难度。

questions.content:
在杨氏双缝干涉实验的基础上，在中间再开一道缝，研究接收屏上的条纹. 已知光源 S 为单色线光源，波长为 $\lambda$. 光源 S 到干涉屏距离为 a. 干涉屏上，上缝与下缝距离为 2b，中缝在其余两缝的正中间. 干涉屏到接收屏距离为 L. 所有光线均满足傍轴条件.

（1） 求接收屏上 x 处的光强，已知 $x=0$ 处，光强为 $I_0$.

（2） 求接收屏上的相邻亮条纹间距.

（3） 小王在做实验的时候发现，S 并非严格的线光源，它具有一定的宽度 s（在垂直于横虚线的方向）.求接收屏上的衬比度. 由于原子发光的无序性，有宽度的光源不同位置之间不相干. 近似保留至 $b/a$ 的一阶项即可.

![](data/images/2023-8387b0d1/2023-校级联考-联考-理论-第六套-7.png)
questions.analysis:
1. 首先计算电场. 中央缝距离光源更近，因此其相位同其余两缝的平均值有一个相位差.

$$E = E_0 \big( e^{-ikb\theta} + e^{-ikc} + e^{ikb\theta} \big) = E_0 \big[ 2\cos(kb\theta) + e^{-ikc} \big]\tag{1}$$

其中 $c = \sqrt{a^2+b^2} - b \approx a^2/2b$

$$I = |E|^2 = E_0^2 \big[ 4\cos^2(kb\theta) + 1 + 4\cos(kb\theta)\cos(kc) \big]\tag{2}$$

在 $\theta=0$ 处，$I = I_0 = E_0^2[4+1+4\cos(kc)]$，又 $\theta = x/L$，因此

$$I = I_0 \frac{4\cos^2\frac{kbx}{L} + 1 + 4\cos\frac{kbx}{L}\cos\frac{ka^2}{2b}}{5 + 4\cos\frac{ka^2}{2b}}\tag{3}$$

2. 对光强求导找极大值.

$$\frac{\mathrm{d}I}{\mathrm{d}\theta} = E_0^2 [ -8kb\sin(kb\theta)\cos(kb\theta) - 4kb\cos(kb\theta)\cos(kc) ] = 0\tag{4}$$

$$\sin(kb\theta)[2\cos(kb\theta) + \cos(kc)] = 0\tag{5}$$

$$kb\theta = n\pi \qquad 极大值\tag{6}$$

$$kb\theta = (2n-1)\pi \pm \arccos\frac{\cos\frac{ka^2}{2b}}{2} \qquad 极小值\tag{7}$$

相邻亮条纹的间距为 $\delta\theta = \frac{\pi}{kb}$，或者

$$d = L\delta\theta = \frac{\pi L}{kb}\tag{8}$$

3. 对于在轴线上方 $y$ 的光源微元，其对三条狭缝发出的光具有额外的光程(从上至下):

$$l_1 = -\frac{b}{\sqrt{a^2+b^2}}y \approx -\frac{bs}{a}\tag{9}$$

$$l_2 = 0\tag{10}$$

$$l_3 \approx \frac{bs}{a}\tag{11}$$

![](data/images/2023-8387b0d1/2023-校级联考-联考-理论-第六套-答案-9.png)

$$E = E_0 \big[ e^{-ikb(\theta+y/a)} + e^{-ikc} + e^{ikb(\theta+y/a)} \big] = E_0 \big\{ 2\cos[kb(\theta+y/a)] + e^{-ikc} \big\}\tag{12}$$

$$I = E_0^2 \big\{ 4\cos^2[kb(\theta+y/a)] + 1 + 4\cos[kb(\theta+y/a)]\cos(kc) \big\}\tag{13}$$

非相干光的光强线性叠加.对y进行积分:

questions.content:
如图（1）所示，一个半径为 $R$ 的圆形管道（在相对于轨道静止的系中为圆形）以速度 $v$ 相对于地面匀速运动。管道内有大量的小球在相对于管道匀速运动，在管道系中，所有小球均以角速度 $\omega$ 相对于圆心匀速旋转。记地面系为 S 系，管道系为 $S'$ 系。在 $S'$ 系中，大量的小球均匀分布，单位长度上的小球个数为 $n_0$。每个小球的静质量为 $m_0$。为方便表示，记 $\beta = v/c$，$c$ 为真空中的光速。忽略圆形管道的宽度。

（1）求在 S 系中，测量到管道的形状，尽量用参数方程表示。

（2）如图（2）若在 S 系中，在较远处看管道，求管道形状。观看时，人眼到管道的距离远大于管道本身的尺寸，我们要求解的是观察者<u>看到</u>管道与观察者连线与 y 轴夹角为 $\varphi$ 时人眼中的成像。

（3）求在 S 系中，管道各处的小球数密度 $n(\theta)$。数密度为单位长度上的小球的个数。我们知道标准方程为 $\frac{x^2}{a^2}+\frac{y^2}{b^2}=1$ 的椭圆也可以用参数方程 $\begin{cases}x=a\cos\theta,\\y=b\sin\theta\end{cases}$ 表示，用此处的 $\theta$ 来简化表达式。

（4）求在 S 系中，管道各处的小球动量密度 $p(\theta)$。动量密度为单位长度上小球的动量。

（5）求在 S 系中，管道各处的力密度 $f(\theta)$。力为小球与管道之间的相互作用力，管道光滑无摩擦。力密度为单位长度管道的受力。

（6）求在 S 系中，管道上半部分与小球之间的相互作用力。

questions.analysis:
$S'$ 参考系中其方程为

$$
x'^2+y'^2=R^2 \tag{1}
$$

坐标变换:

$$
x'=\frac{x-\beta ct}{\sqrt{1-\beta^2}},\quad y'=y,\quad ct'=\frac{ct-\beta x}{\sqrt{1-\beta^2}} \tag{2}
$$

$$
\frac{(x-\beta ct)^2}{1-\beta^2}+y^2=R^2 \tag{3}
$$

$$
x=\beta ct+R\sqrt{1-\beta^2}\cos\theta \tag{4}
$$

$$
y=R\sin\theta \tag{5}
$$

2. (5”)人眼中的像由同一时刻抵达的光构成，看到的像实际上是人的光锥对圆环划过的世界线簇的截面。设点 $(x,y)$ 于 $t$ 时刻发出的光与圆环中心 $(0,0)$ 在 $t=0$ 发出的光被同时观测到。$(x,y)$ 到人眼的距离与圆心相差

$$
\delta s=y\cos\varphi-x\sin\varphi \tag{6}
$$

因此它需要在时刻 $t=-\delta s/c$ 发出光才能与圆心的光同时抵达人眼。将 $t$ 代入上一问求得的方程:

$$
\frac{(x+\beta y\cos\varphi-\beta x\sin\varphi)^2}{1-\beta^2}+y^2=R^2 \tag{7}
$$

3. [15”]考虑 $S'$ 系中位于 $(x',y',ct')$ 的小球，其在 S 系中的坐标是

$$
x=\frac{x'+\beta ct'}{\sqrt{1-\beta^2}} \tag{8}
$$

$$
y=y' \tag{9}
$$

$$
ct=\frac{ct'+\beta x'}{\sqrt{1-\beta^2}} \tag{10}
$$

在极坐标中:

$$
\beta ct+R\sqrt{1-\beta^2}\cos\theta=\frac{R\cos\theta'+\beta ct'}{\sqrt{1-\beta^2}} \tag{11}
$$

$$
R\sin\theta=R\sin\theta' \tag{12}
$$

$$
ct=\frac{ct'+\beta R\cos\theta'}{\sqrt{1-\beta^2}} \tag{13}
$$

考虑两个相邻小球，其坐标分别为 $\theta,\theta+\Delta\theta$，$t=0$。$S'$ 系中，这两个事件具有时间差:

$$
c\Delta t'=-\beta R\cos(\theta+\Delta\theta)+\beta R\cos\theta=\beta R\Delta\theta\sin\theta \tag{14}
$$

由于小球以 $\omega$ 运动，两个时间之间的实际距离是

$$
\Delta\theta=\frac{2\pi}{2\pi R n_0}+\omega\Delta t'=\frac{1}{R n_0}+\frac{\omega\beta R}{c}\Delta\theta\sin\theta \tag{15}
$$

解得

$$
\Delta\theta=\frac{1}{n_0 R}\frac{1}{1-\frac{\beta\omega R}{c}\sin\theta} \tag{16}
$$

因此

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}N}{\mathrm{d}\theta}_S=\frac{1}{\Delta\theta}=n_0 R\left(1-\frac{\beta\omega R}{c}\sin\theta\right) \tag{17}
$$

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}l}{\mathrm{d}\theta}_S=R\sqrt{(1-\beta^2)\sin^2\theta+\cos^2\theta}=R\sqrt{1-\beta^2\sin^2\theta} \tag{18}
$$

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}N}{\mathrm{d}l}_S=\frac{\mathrm{d}N}{\mathrm{d}\theta}_S\frac{\mathrm{d}\theta}{\mathrm{d}l}_S=\frac{n_0\left(1-\frac{\beta\omega R}{c}\sin\theta\right)}{\sqrt{1-\beta^2\sin^2\theta}} \tag{19}
$$

4. [15”]位于 $\theta$ 处的小球在 $S'$ 系中具有大小为 $p'=m_0\omega R/\sqrt{1-\omega^2R^2/c^2}$ 的动量

$$
p'_{0x}=-\frac{m_0\omega R\sin\theta}{\sqrt{1-\frac{\omega^2R^2}{c^2}}} \tag{20}
$$

$$
p'_{0y}=\frac{m_0\omega R\cos\theta}{\sqrt{1-\frac{\omega^2R^2}{c^2}}} \tag{21}
$$

$$
E'=\frac{m_0c^2}{\sqrt{1-\frac{\omega^2R^2}{c^2}}} \tag{22}
$$

变换到 S 系中:

$$
p_{0x}=\frac{p'_{0x}+\beta E'/c}{\sqrt{1-\beta^2}}=m_0\frac{\beta c-\omega R\sin\theta}{\sqrt{1-\beta^2}\sqrt{1-\frac{\omega^2R^2}{c^2}}} \tag{23}
$$

$$
p_{0y}=p'_{0y}=\frac{m_0\omega R\cos\theta}{\sqrt{1-\frac{\omega^2R^2}{c^2}}} \tag{24}
$$

动量密度是动量与数密度的乘积

$$
p=n p_0=\frac{n_0m_0\left(1-\frac{\beta\omega R}{c}\sin\theta\right)}{\sqrt{1-\beta^2\sin^2\theta}\sqrt{1-\frac{\omega^2R^2}{c^2}}}\left(\frac{\beta c-\omega R\sin\theta}{\sqrt{1-\beta^2}}\hat{\boldsymbol{x}}+\omega R\cos\theta\hat{\boldsymbol{y}}\right) \tag{25}
$$

5. (15’)考察 S 系中 $\theta$ 处 $\delta N$ 个小球的动量变化。这些小球占据长度

$$
\delta l=\delta N/(\mathrm{d}N/\mathrm{d}l)=\frac{\sqrt{1-\beta^2\sin^2\theta}}{n_0\left(1-\frac{\beta\omega R}{c}\sin\theta\right)}\delta N \tag{26}
$$

具有动量

$$
\delta p_0=p\delta l=\frac{\delta N m_0}{\sqrt{1-\frac{\omega^2R^2}{c^2}}}\left(\frac{\beta c-\omega R\sin\theta}{\sqrt{1-\beta^2}}\hat{\boldsymbol{x}}+\omega R\cos\theta\hat{\boldsymbol{y}}\right) \tag{27}
$$

这些小球运动中受力

$$
\delta\boldsymbol{F}=-\boldsymbol{f}\delta l \tag{28}
$$

经过时间 $\mathrm{d}t$，小球经过 $\mathrm{d}\theta=\omega\mathrm{d}t$。过程中其动量改变量等于所受总冲量

$$
\mathrm{d}\delta p_0=\delta F\mathrm{d}t \tag{29}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}
\boldsymbol{f}&=-\frac{\delta F}{\delta l}=-\frac{\omega}{\delta l}\frac{\mathrm{d}\delta p_0}{\mathrm{d}\theta}=\frac{\delta N m_0}{\sqrt{1-\frac{\omega^2R^2}{c^2}}}\left(\frac{\omega R\cos\theta}{\sqrt{1-\beta^2}}\hat{\boldsymbol{x}}+\omega R\sin\theta\hat{\boldsymbol{y}}\right)\frac{\omega}{\delta l}\\
&=\frac{n_0m_0\omega^2R\left(1-\frac{\beta\omega R}{c}\sin\theta\right)}{\sqrt{1-\beta^2\sin^2\theta}\sqrt{1-\frac{\omega^2R^2}{c^2}}}\left(\frac{\cos\theta}{\sqrt{1-\beta^2}}\hat{\boldsymbol{x}}+\sin\theta\hat{\boldsymbol{y}}\right)
\end{aligned} \tag{30}
$$

6. [5”]对管道长度积分

$$
\begin{aligned}
\boldsymbol{F}&=\int\mathrm{d}l\,\boldsymbol{f}=\int_0^\pi\mathrm{d}\theta\,\boldsymbol{f}\frac{\mathrm{d}l}{\mathrm{d}\theta}=\int_0^\pi\mathrm{d}\theta\,\frac{n_0m_0\omega^2R^2\left(1-\frac{\beta\omega R}{c}\sin\theta\right)}{\sqrt{1-\frac{\omega^2R^2}{c^2}}}\left(\frac{\cos\theta}{\sqrt{1-\beta^2}}\hat{x}+\sin\theta\hat{y}\right)\\
&=\frac{n_0m_0\omega^2R^2\hat{y}}{\sqrt{1-\frac{\omega^2R^2}{c^2}}}\int_0^\pi\mathrm{d}\theta\left(1-\frac{\beta\omega R}{c}\sin\theta\right)\sin\theta=\frac{n_0m_0\omega^2R^2\hat{y}}{\sqrt{1-\frac{\omega^2R^2}{c^2}}}\left(2-\frac{\pi\beta\omega R}{2c}\right)
\end{aligned} \tag{31}
$$

questions.answer:
（1）管道形状参数方程：$x=\beta ct+R\sqrt{1-\beta^2}\cos\theta$，$y=R\sin\theta$。

（2）人眼成像满足方程：$\frac{(x+\beta y\cos\varphi-\beta x\sin\varphi)^2}{1-\beta^2}+y^2=R^2$。

（3）数密度：$n(\theta)=\frac{n_0\left(1-\frac{\beta\omega R}{c}\sin\theta\right)}{\sqrt{1-\beta^2\sin^2\theta}}$。

（4）动量密度：$\boldsymbol{p}(\theta)=\frac{n_0m_0\left(1-\frac{\beta\omega R}{c}\sin\theta\right)}{\sqrt{1-\beta^2\sin^2\theta}\sqrt{1-\frac{\omega^2R^2}{c^2}}}\left(\frac{\beta c-\omega R\sin\theta}{\sqrt{1-\beta^2}}\hat{\boldsymbol{x}}+\omega R\cos\theta\hat{\boldsymbol{y}}\right)$。

（5）力密度：$\boldsymbol{f}(\theta)=\frac{n_0m_0\omega^2R\left(1-\frac{\beta\omega R}{c}\sin\theta\right)}{\sqrt{1-\beta^2\sin^2\theta}\sqrt{1-\frac{\omega^2R^2}{c^2}}}\left(\frac{\cos\theta}{\sqrt{1-\beta^2}}\hat{\boldsymbol{x}}+\sin\theta\hat{\boldsymbol{y}}\right)$。

（6）上半部分总作用力：$\boldsymbol{F}=\frac{n_0m_0\omega^2R^2}{\sqrt{1-\frac{\omega^2R^2}{c^2}}}\left(2-\frac{\pi\beta\omega R}{2c}\right)\hat{\boldsymbol{y}}$。
